name: Azuma Airi
source:
Likes: Cute things, animals (especially cats!),  [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_bean_paste]Anko[/url].
Favorite things: To love cats.
Hobbies: Looking for stray cats
Strong points: Cooking, handicraft
Disadvantages: Cannot simply walk past animals.
Dogs or Cats? ⇒ I prefer cats! But I like all animals.
